long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Skalica, Ivan Kmotrík entered business after the fall of communism. In 1995 he took a capital stake in Grafobal and became chairman of its supervisory board. He used the packaging and printing company as the foundation for a wider group. Its portfolio grew to include press distribution, property development, healthcare and other operations across several countries.

Kmotrík became owner, president and chairman of ŠK Slovan Bratislava. The club developed into the dominant force in Slovak football under his ownership, while his son Ivan Kmotrík Jr assumed major executive responsibilities. He also brought his wife and children into Grafobal Group governance, turning the enterprise into a multigenerational family holding.
